pilot_scope.purpose: Labeling and event-generation validation only for the replacement-core pilot. This pilot does NOT train final models, meta-layer, calibration, walk-forward/OOS execution, or decision policy.
pilot_scope.cusum_k_and_sma_fixed: Pilot locks CUSUM k=0.7 and SMA(8,21) only. Full Step 2.5 candidate sets (multiple k, SMA pairs) run in the main grid sweep after pilot PASS (tracked in OPEN_ITEMS).
pilot_scope.output_authority: pilot_summary.json is authoritative; pilot_summary.csv is a flattened convenience copy for spreadsheets.
pilot_scope.non_promotion: Pilot results MUST NOT be promoted to production or wired into live signal authority.
pilot_scope.legacy_non_authority: No legacy directional stack, fusion, multi_horizon_decision, call_engine trade semantics, outcome_*c labels, or prediction cards have authority over this pilot.

lopez_de_prado: event-based sampling (CUSUM events, not every bar)
meta-labeling planned; OOF-only for meta (not in pilot scaffold)
purged CV / embargo / sample uniqueness: NOT_IMPLEMENTED_IN_PILOT_V1
no forward-return proxy as authoritative label for this pilot
hudson_thames_discipline: feature contracts and label contracts (this prereg + future IDs)
walk-forward / OOF: walk-forward not executed in pilot_v1 scaffold
no silent fallbacks in pilot runner
separation: data / events / labels / models / meta / policy (models+meta deferred)

no_legacy_authority_statement: The legacy directional signal stack, outcome_*c labels, fusion, multi_horizon_decision product authority, call_engine trade semantics, secondary horizons 3c/8c/13c, and prediction cards are NOT authoritative for this pilot. This pilot is research-only and not promoted to production.

cusum.description: pos=max(0,pos+z-k); neg=max(0,neg-z-k); event when pos>=h or neg>=h; z = simple return / sigma_contract EWM std (continuous RTH tape; optional causal relative floor)

entry.description: Entry price is open of first 1m bar strictly after signal bar close; label path simulation starts at that bar.

atr.description: ATR-14 using Wilder smoothing computed at close of bar T-1, excluding the event bar to avoid CUSUM-selection bias in barrier sizing.
atr.note: Do not use math_volatility.compute_atr (SMA of TR) for authoritative pilot labels. Barrier width uses atr_series[i_sig-1], not i_sig.

same_bar.conservative_long: if stop and target both touched same bar, assume stop first (LOSS)
same_bar.conservative_short: if stop and target both touched same bar, assume stop first (LOSS)
same_bar.reject: if both touched same bar, label_reject=REJECT for divergence monitoring
